LHX.sentence: L3Harris has badly lagged the other big defense contractors over the past month even though nothing changed about its business, so it looks like a case of the market catching up rather than a real problem.

ASML.sentence: ASML is quiet and sitting near its record highs, which is just business as usual for the only company that makes a certain essential chipmaking machine.

LIN.sentence: Linde is quiet, though unusually its shares are priced no richer than a rival's despite it being the strongest player in the industrial gas business — a rare little bargain for the best name in the group.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft has been on a strong run, well ahead of similar companies, as the AI-cloud story keeps grinding along without any drama.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher dipped a little, but money is flowing back into biotech research again, and that funding tends to turn into lab-equipment orders for them a few quarters down the road.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge is quiet — its pipelines act like toll roads and pay a solid dividend, though the stock isn't especially cheap right now.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow slipped again and is now well off its highs, which is unusual for such a steady grower — corporate and government customers keep signing up for its AI-automation tools.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore has lagged even as copper prices have been surging, so it may have some catching up to do given how much of its business is tied to that metal.

RDDT.sentence: Reddit jumped sharply after posting very strong advertising growth — the market has been worried Google might send it fewer visitors, but the results so far show the opposite of that fear.

KOF.sentence: Coca-Cola FEMSA is quiet and inexpensive, with the Mexican peso stable, so this steady Latin American Coke bottler is just plugging along.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras is quiet, with oil prices comfortably high enough to keep its very large dividend well covered.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the container-shipping giant, has rallied hard this stretch, and despite the run the shares still trade below the value of the company's own assets.

MA.sentence: Mastercard is quiet, and unusually it's priced slightly cheaper than Visa right now even though people keep tapping their cards more than ever.

ISRG.sentence: Intuitive Surgical, the da Vinci surgical robot company, has been sold off hard out of fear, but there's no sign hospitals are actually using its machines any less — so this looks like nervousness rather than a real problem.
